comparison.objective: Hold a self-closing gate open while sliding a parcel through to a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustain gate restraint with one hand while pushing a parcel through a constrained opening with the other.
comparison.success_condition: Parcel reaches run-off plate without gate contact or lifting, gate closes, arms withdraw.
comparison.reason: Tests simultaneous restraint and transfer through a moving mechanism, not fine adjustment, fastener torque, or repeated carriage-stop commissioning.
